title: MED+250 source-data publication and reuse approval
summary: Owner-ready signed decision for publication and operational reuse of every active medicine, consumer-product, pharmacy, contact, geospatial, image and central indicative-price source. Technical source capture is complete, but the paired source ledger and durable-storage location still require owner decisions and no reuse approval is inferred.

checks.name: Complete source review ledger
checks.detail: The paired nine-record source ledger has no remaining technical retention blocker, but all nine publication and operational-reuse decisions still require a named data owner.

checks.name: Immutable raw source retention
checks.detail: A checksum-bound private bundle retains 25 exact Amazon, Rwanda FDA, derived-release and governance artifacts. The data owner must approve its durable storage location or move the unchanged verified bundle to an approved evidence store.

checks.name: Publication and operational reuse permission
checks.detail: The data owner has not yet recorded a lawful publication and operational-reuse basis for every active source class, derived dataset and displayed field.

checks.name: Amazon scope and price exclusion
checks.detail: The paired ledger records Amazon only as taxonomy and product-reference research, confirms Amazon prices are absent, and does not treat Amazon availability as Rwanda market authorisation.

checks.name: Attribution, refresh and withdrawal conditions
checks.detail: Required attribution, source versioning, refresh cadence, correction, removal, withdrawal and regulator or rights-holder response procedures have not yet been approved.

checks.name: Product image and content rights
checks.detail: The data owner must confirm that only rights-verified product images and lawfully reusable product content can become public and that unverified material remains hidden.

checks.name: Named data-owner signature
checks.detail: The accountable data owner has not yet recorded the final scope, exclusions, conditions, decision, named approver, role and timezone-qualified approval timestamp.

completion_instructions: Approve the current controlled bundle location or move the unchanged bundle to an approved durable evidence store and retain its verified manifest digest.
Resolve every pending source-class record in the paired review ledger.
Record the publication and operational-reuse basis, attribution, retention, refresh, correction, withdrawal and takedown conditions for every approved source.
Remove or replace every source or derived field that is not approved for the intended public or operational use.
Confirm the completed review-ledger digest and update this artifact if the ledger changed.
Set every check to passed, set decision to approved, add the named approver, role and timezone-qualified timestamp, and set status to complete.
Validate both completed artifacts strictly and add them to the launch registry only with their exact SHA-256 digests.
